sources.title: fractal README
sources.locator: intro; WARNING; Installation; Usage; parameter list
sources.finding: Trees of autonomous agent loops, each node in its own git worktree with hard caps (iterations, depth, children, cost, time); five agent backends; TUI over a local SQLite database; nodes run without permission prompts by default.

sources.locator: whole file
sources.finding: Apache License 2.0 for the repository.

sources.finding: First-party descriptive wiki shipped in the repository documenting architecture, configuration, design, features and operator journeys.

sources.title: fractal wiki: worktrees
sources.locator: Where worktrees live; Forking a child
sources.finding: One git worktree per node in a per-node directory named by its branch under the repository worktrees folder; a child forks the parent branch tip; tree-wide flock serialises worktree add and spawn caps.

sources.title: fractal wiki: agent providers
sources.locator: Supported backends; The registry; Provider routes
sources.finding: Five backends (claude, codex, grok, opencode, omp) registered by base command; routes such as OpenRouter; register() as an in-process extension point.

sources.title: fractal wiki: extending agents
sources.locator: extension seam; deployment hook file; telemetry
sources.finding: Embedding applications register or override agent backends in process or through a per-tree deployment hook file; the package itself ships no telemetry.

sources.title: fractal wiki: models and effort
sources.locator: model and effort overrides
sources.finding: Per-node model and reasoning-effort overrides; Claude and Codex seeds pin effort high.

sources.title: fractal wiki: getting started
sources.locator: Install; fractal init; fractal node init; NODE.md
sources.finding: Install via pip, run fractal install for skills, fractal init on a git branch, fractal node init with budgets and scope, author NODE.md instructions and completion requirements, launch in tmux (or --headless).

sources.title: fractal wiki: operating
sources.locator: Monitoring; Steering
sources.finding: node list/status/activity/cost, TUI cockpit, tmux attach, radio feed; steering through radio directives, NODE.md edits, chat, retunes, approvals and lifecycle verbs.

sources.title: fractal wiki: finishing
sources.locator: The finish signal; What merge does
sources.finding: finish ends a node after its iteration and lands completed or exited by reason; merge squash-merges the node branch into its merge target after operator review.

sources.title: fractal wiki: merge guards
sources.locator: refusals; repo-wide merge lock; paused nodes
sources.finding: Merge refuses while the node or target is active, on dirty target worktrees and untracked-file or footprint conflicts; merges are serialised by a repo-wide lock.

sources.title: fractal wiki: durability
sources.locator: Paused is active-like; Park semantics
sources.finding: Pause parks the loop as a full process exit keeping run, iteration and step rows open so resume continues the same run; survives reboot or host migration.

sources.title: fractal wiki: statuses
sources.locator: One status set, two homes
sources.finding: One status vocabulary across node status file and database rows (idle, active, paused, completed, exited, failed, retired); a healer reconciles crashed loops.

sources.title: fractal wiki: tree limits
sources.locator: three caps and the budget check
sources.finding: Width, depth and descendants caps plus a spawn-time budget check enforced without agent cooperation.

sources.title: fractal wiki: cost budgets
sources.locator: three cap tiers; subtree-shared; Reserve window
sources.finding: max_cost per run (subtree-shared), max_iter_cost, max_step_cost; reserve window steers wind-down; non-enforcing agents warn only.

sources.title: fractal wiki: cost measurement
sources.locator: per-step ledger rows; unknowable cost recorded as null
sources.finding: Per-step cost rows in the central database roll up through iterations, runs and descendants; unknowable cost is stored null and disclosed, not zero.

sources.title: fractal wiki: pricing
sources.locator: LiteLLM price table; unpriced model contract
sources.finding: Token usage becomes dollars from a cached LiteLLM price table; refresh and staleness semantics; unpriced models disclosed.

sources.title: fractal wiki: time budgets
sources.locator: run, iteration and step timeout tiers; pause credit-back
sources.finding: Run, iteration and step timeouts with pause credit-back so frozen time does not charge deadlines.

sources.title: fractal wiki: radio
sources.locator: Radio is fractal inter-node messaging
sources.finding: Inter-node messaging in fractal/core/radio.py: channels, send/post/reply, subscriptions, read receipts, reactions, saved messages, all in the central database.

sources.title: fractal wiki: chat
sources.locator: conversational door onto a node
sources.finding: fractal node chat sends one prompt to a node agent in a fresh, forked or resumed session without writing cost rows or disturbing the loop.

sources.title: fractal wiki: TUI actions
sources.locator: Radio writes; Session viewing; What the cockpit never does
sources.finding: The TUI cockpit is read-only by construction except radio send/reply/react/save, chat and read-only tmux attach; lifecycle changes stay on the CLI.

sources.title: fractal wiki: plans
sources.locator: Creating plans; Listing plans
sources.finding: fractal plan init/list create markdown plan files per iteration named timestamp-run.iter-name.md.

sources.title: fractal wiki: commit pipeline
sources.locator: single path into git history; scope, refresh, lint
sources.finding: fractal commit runs scope check, wiki index refresh, lint, stage, commit and push (unless --local) as one operation with enforced subject discipline.

sources.title: fractal wiki: transcripts
sources.locator: Resolution
sources.finding: Provider session transcripts resolved per agent through the node sessions facade; session ids stored on step and iteration rows.

sources.title: fractal wiki: knowledge stores

sources.finding: Project wiki and per-node memory implemented with the plasma-wiki CLI as shared knowledge bases nodes read and grow.
